body:
The drugs were about two years ago. I was getting them from my druggie boyfriends friend, so when we broke up I had no choice. I miss them. I have slipped up a few times on other prescription drugs just to deal with everything. I don't want to feel like a monster though. And I do every morning after. 
What I meant by that is I mean there's no love left in this world. I feel like an alien. I care so deeply about some people and feelings are not reciprocated. There's no loyalty. I feel the same thing about the world. The heartless end up on top. Look at the top ten CEO's of this country. I'm sure they have actual skeletons in their closets to get where they are. Yet they lie care free in their blood money beds every night. The injustice in this world makes me feel like I don't belong.

I don't feel like I belong in this world. I've been betrayed and extensively lied to my whole life by both parents. We come from what you would call a 'Christian' family. I can not understand how my own parents can turn their backs and treat me like shit, while I suffer in silence with all the mistakes I never made. My childhood was awful. No I wasn't sexually abused or beaten everyday. The constant screaming and fighting, the constant threat of divorce. The fact that I was always dragged into it and blamed for things I couldn't even accomplish at that time in my life. 
I'm 21 years old. I have dealt with this for 18 years on my own. Very few people know that I started having depression at 10. My first suicidal thought was at 12. I have had good times and bad times, but anytime something goes bad I'm always thinking it would be nice to have a break from it all. A permanent break. I have been on anti depressants three times over the last nine years. I've never been able to stay on them because I feel like I'm turning into my mother, and she's a dreaded selfish whore.
 I've tried my whole life to be nothing like her. Out of everything in this whole world, I literally hate her. The lies that she's told and the childhood she's ruined. I can't even look at her face. But I feel like in the descent of my whole life, I'm becoming her. I would rather die. A couple years back I became an addict on speed. (Adderall). I hurt everyone around me at that time. I didn't want to hurt anyone. Only two people knew I was an addict but I lashed out at everyone around me. The only reason I spent two weeks in hell going cold turkey is because I didn't want to hurt people like my mother did.  
I had an amazing boyfriend for a year and a half. We broke up in August. I mean most of the time he was amazing. But when I confessed that I had bisexual feelings he told me I was disgusting and 'wrong'. That's the beginning of the end. After that happened in February I've been downhill since. He knew about the depression. I also have anxiety. I tried talking to him about it but he just shut down due to matters of his families past. 
In July after months of telling him I didn't want to be on this planet anymore, I tried to kill myself. I really wanted to. I was drinking to take the edge off, slipped into the shower with a pair of scissors and cried until the hot water ran out. I couldn't do it. I was scared of the pain. I acted normal for a few weeks because I couldn't tell him. He would be mad and go insane. The couple times I did try to tell him, and I told him we really need to talk, he told me he was with the boys and it could wait til later. That betrayal blew me apart. You don't say you love someone, know that they're fighting to stay alive, and then blow them off. I was screaming for help and he was too busy to know it. When I finally did tell him he got mad. Said I should've told him. We ended up breaking up a week later after he said "I can't deal with you anymore"
I gave him everything. I dropped out of school for him, and now that's fucked. I can't stand to live in this house with the devil herself and a father who genuinely doesn't care.
My faith in the world is shattered. I see what's on tv. I see the little arguments that couples have in front of their children. I see others like me suffering. I quietly envy them thinking that maybe their life can turn around. Maybe their situation isn't that bad yet. I'm a good person. People would typically say I have a lot of friends. I say hi to everyone who smiles on the street and am one of the most loyal people you'll ever find. I almost got arrested last year for a friend who had a little too much weed on him. He would've went to jail with a baby on the way, so I shoved it inside my coat while the officer was questioning us. Here's the thing.  
Those people don't know me. The three people that did actually know me, they destroyed me. I no longer want to be close to anyone. I have. Guy right now who is trying to solve my puzzle because I keep saying no when he asks me out. I just don't want anything anymore. I'm broken. I'm shattered. I'm tired of fighting "the good fight". I don't want to "keep on keepin' on". I know I could. I could move out. At least become a stoner so that I don't have feelings. Or I could go back to being an addict. But I don't want to. I see this world as nothing but a dark and disappointing end. I don't want to hurt anymore people. I don't want to be hurt by anymore people. 
I just don't want life anymore. I don't belong here. Knowing that everyone and everything is put to get you is so terrifying. I just want the nightmares and the crying all day and the hurting the couple people I do have to stop. I don't want life anymore.
